title: 第286章 练兵第285章 整合完毕

忙了这好几个月，天枢局那边也没闲着。案子一个接一个地来，不过现在跟以前不一样了，底下的人能顶起来了，不用啥事都王建新亲自出马。
草原上那个案子办得就挺漂亮。
事情出在内蒙古边境线上。那边有个边防哨所，养了好几条军犬，都是正经八百训练出来的，平时听话得很。可是有一段日子，那些军犬一到晚上就跟疯了似的，冲着围栏外面嗷嗷叫，还使劲往铁丝网上撞，撞得鼻青脸肿的也不停。喂食也不吃，水也不喝，几天下来瘦了一圈。
哨所的兽医看了好几遍，查不出毛病。没有传染病，身上也没有伤，它就是不对劲。连长觉得蹊跷，把事情报上去了。
一开始当地团部去人看过，没看出啥名堂。后来又来了军区保卫部门的人，带着仪器测了半天，也没发现啥异常。这事儿就一层一层报到了天枢局。
王建新看了报告，觉得不像是普通的动物发疯。军犬都是经过严格训练的，集体出现这种反常行为，背后肯定有原因。他把案子交给了外勤中队，特意嘱咐了一句：带几个新人去，练练兵。
这次出任务的是一个小组，三个老队员带七个新队员。老队员里头有个叫赵铁军的，是原来天枢局的老侦查员，干了多年的外勤，经验老到。另外两个也都是老手，一个懂技术，一个懂蒙语。七个新人都是刚从那一百人名单里挑出来的，虽然还没开始修真，但底子都不差，身体素质过硬，脑子也灵活。
一帮人到了边境哨所，先没急着下结论，而是分头行动。老赵带着两个人去跟哨兵聊天，了解情况。技术员带着仪器去周边测数据。剩下的人负责观察军犬的行为。
查了三天，线索慢慢浮出来了。
第一，军犬发疯的时间高度一致，都是每天晚上十点到凌晨两点之间。第二，发疯的时候，哨所的无线电会有轻微的干扰，电台里能听到一种很低很闷的嗡嗡声，不是一直有，断断续续的。第三，好几个哨兵反映，那段时间站岗的时候总觉得眼睛花，看东西不清楚，人也特别容易犯困，比平时累得多。
老赵把这些情况一合计，觉得不对劲。他让人把仪器架在哨所最高的那个岗楼上，连续监测了一整夜。果然，在军犬开始狂叫的那个时间段，仪器捕捉到了一种低频声波，频率很低很低，人的耳朵听不见，但是动物能感觉到。这种声波对动物的神经系统有刺激作用，时间长了能让它们烦躁不安、食欲不振，甚至产生攻击性。
技术员又测了几天，把声波的来源方向锁定了——来自国境线那边，大约两三公里远的地方。
老赵二话不说，带着人摸黑出了哨所。七个新人跟在后面，第一次执行这种任务，紧张得手心冒汗。老赵走在最前面，一边走一边用手势指挥，步子又轻又快，新人们看着他的背影，心说这哪像是快五十岁的人，比他们这些年轻人都利索。
走了将近一个钟头，到了边境线附近。老赵让人分散开，自己拿着仪器慢慢往前摸。在一处地势比较低洼的草地里，他发现了一个被人为伪装过的土包。扒开草皮和伪装网，底下是一台银白色的设备，巴掌大小，连着一个小型的太阳能电池板。设备上印着外文，谁生产的不用说了。
老赵没急着拆，先拍了照片，然后把设备小心翼翼地取下来，断了电源。他让技术员把设备的频率、信号特征全部记录下来，然后让人在周边搜索。不到半个小时，又在另外两个地方发现了同样的装置。三台设备呈三角形分布，正好覆盖了对面哨所的区域。
就在这时候，新来的一个小队员发现了一个情况——草地上有几道新鲜的轮胎印，顺着国境线往东延伸。老赵当机立断，让两个人回去报信，剩下的人顺着轮胎印追。
追了十来里地，在一处废弃的牧民房子里，他们截住了两个人。两个都是外国人，身上带着地图、望远镜、高频电台，还有几块备用电池。老赵带人冲进去的时候，其中一个还想掏东西，被一个新队员一脚踢飞了，三下五除二就按在了地上。
人赃俱获。
后来一查，这两个人是邻国情报机构派来的特工，专门研究边境哨所的防御弱点。他们发现这一带的地磁场比较弱，适合搞低频声波干扰，就偷偷布设了那几台装置，专门针对军犬和哨兵进行心理战。时间长了，军犬废了，哨兵的警惕性也下降了，他们就有机可乘了。

天枢局把设备拆了运回去，人押走了。临走之前，老赵还帮哨所那边建立了一套草原边境地磁监测网，以后哪块地磁场有异常，这边马上就能知道，不会再让人钻空子。
前后不到二十天，案子办得干净利落。那几个新人回来之后，一个个眼睛都亮了。
在部队的时候，他们都觉得自己是尖子，是特种兵，厉害得不行。到了天枢局才发现，厉害的人多了去了。老赵那身手，那经验，那判断力，甩他们几条街。更别说还有那位传说中的王局长，人家那才叫真正的本事。这帮新人算是彻底服了，知道自己以前那点能耐，在天枢局根本不够看。
接下来的日子，王建新就把这当成了练兵的机会。
749局整合过来之后，情报能力上了一个大台阶。以前很多案子要靠天枢局自己摸排，费时费力。现在好了，749局那边隔三差五就送过来一堆情报分析报告，什么案子的背景、线索、相关人物，都搞得清清楚楚。天枢局要做的，就是派人去核实、去抓捕、去处置。
案子五花八门，什么样的都有。有间谍案，有走私案，有文物盗掘案，还有一些说不清道不明的灵异事件。王建新把十个外勤中队排了个班，轮着出任务。这个月一中队去东北，二中队去西南，三中队去华北。每个案子都是一次实战锻炼，既练单兵能力，也练团队配合，还练随机应变。
几个副局长也各有分工。秦怀洲负责统筹调度，陆惊鸿负责训练和战术指导，苏砚秋负责情报对接和技术支持。大家各司其职，忙而不乱。王建新省了不少心，可以腾出手来管那些大事。
到了年底，总算没那么忙了。
青海那边的工程进入冬歇期，零下二三十度的天气，混凝土都冻住了，没法施工。工程兵部队撤下来休整，等来年开春再接着干。京城的百人名单也定了，培训方案也做好了，就等着基地建好。

After being busy for several months, Tianshu Bureau has not been idle either. Cases are coming one after another, but now it is different from before. The people below are able to stand up, and Wang Jianxin does not need to personally take action in everything.
The case on the grassland was handled beautifully.
The incident occurred on the border of Inner Mongolia. There is a border guard post over there, which has several military dogs. They are all trained seriously and are usually very obedient. But there was a time when those military dogs went crazy at night, howling at the outside of the fence, and hitting the barbed wire fence hard, causing bruises and swollen faces. I didn't eat or drink any food, and I lost a lot of weight in a few days.
The veterinarian at the outpost looked at it several times and couldn't find anything wrong. There was no contagion, no injuries, it just wasn't right. The company commander felt something strange and reported the matter.
At first, people from the local regiment headquarters went to look at it, but they didn’t see much of it. Later, people from the security department of the military region came and took instruments to measure for a long time, but found nothing abnormal. This matter was reported to Tianshu Bureau level by level.
Wang Jianxin read the report and felt that it was not like an ordinary animal going crazy. Military dogs are strictly trained, and there must be a reason behind this abnormal behavior. He handed the case over to the field squadron and gave special instructions: Bring a few newcomers to practice.
This time, a team was sent on the mission, with three old team members and seven new team members. Among the old team members was a man named Zhao Tiejun, who was an old investigator from the Tianshu Bureau. He had been working in the field for many years and was very experienced. The other two are also veterans, one understands technology and the other understands Mongolian. The seven newcomers were all just selected from the list of one hundred people. Although they haven't started practicing yet, their foundations are not bad. They have excellent physical fitness and flexible minds.
When a group of people arrived at the border post, they did not rush to a conclusion, but split up. Lao Zhao took two people to chat with the sentry to understand the situation. The technician took the instrument to the surrounding area to measure data. The remaining people are responsible for observing the behavior of the military dogs.
After three days of investigation, clues slowly emerged.
First, the time when military dogs go crazy is highly consistent, between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m. every day. Second, when you go crazy, there will be slight interference on the radio at the outpost. You can hear a low and dull buzzing sound on the radio, which is not always there, but intermittently. Third, several sentries reported that they always felt dazzled and couldn't see clearly when standing guard during that period. They also felt sleepy easily and were much more tired than usual.
Lao Zhao took these situations together and felt something was wrong. He had the instrument set up on the highest watchtower of the post and monitored it continuously throughout the night. Sure enough, at the time when the military dogs started barking, the instrument captured a low-frequency sound wave. The frequency was so low that it was inaudible to human ears, but animals could feel it. This kind of sound wave has a stimulating effect on the nervous system of animals. Over time, it can make them irritable, lose appetite, and even become aggressive.
The technicians conducted measurements for several more days and determined the direction of the source of the sound waves—from the other side of the border, about two or three kilometers away.
Without saying a word, Lao Zhao led his men out of the post in the dark. Seven newcomers followed, performing this kind of task for the first time, and their palms were sweating from nervousness. Lao Zhao walked in the front, directing with hand gestures as he walked, walking light and fast. The newcomers looked at his back and thought that he didn't look like a man who was almost fifty years old. He was more nimble than young people like them.
After walking for nearly an hour, we arrived near the border. Lao Zhao asked people to disperse, and he slowly moved forward with the instrument. In a relatively low-lying grassland, he found a camouflaged earth bag. After peeling back the turf and camouflage net, underneath was a silver-white device, about the size of a palm, connected to a small solar panel. There are foreign languages ​​printed on the equipment, and it goes without saying who produced them.
Lao Zhao was not in a hurry to dismantle it. He took photos first and then resized the equipment.He carefully took it off and cut off the power supply. He asked technicians to record all the frequency and signal characteristics of the equipment, and then asked people to search the surrounding area. Within half an hour, the same device was found in two other places. The three devices were distributed in a triangle, covering the area of ​​the opposite post.
At this time, a new team member discovered something - there were several fresh tire tracks on the grass, extending eastward along the border. Lao Zhao made a prompt decision and asked two people to go back to report the news, while the remaining people followed the tire tracks and chased him.
After chasing for more than ten miles, they intercepted two people in an abandoned herdsman's house. Both were foreigners, carrying maps, telescopes, high-frequency radios, and a few spare batteries. When Lao Zhao led the people to rush in, one of them wanted to take something out, but was kicked away by a new team member and pinned to the ground three times.
Everyone gets the stolen goods.
Later investigation revealed that the two men were agents sent by the intelligence agencies of neighboring countries to study the defensive weaknesses of border posts. They found that the geomagnetic field in this area was relatively weak and suitable for low-frequency sound wave interference, so they secretly deployed a few devices to conduct psychological warfare against military dogs and sentries. As time passed, the military dogs became useless and the vigilance of the sentries also dropped, giving them an opportunity to take advantage.
The Tianshu Bureau dismantled the equipment, transported it back, and escorted it away. Before leaving, Lao Zhao also helped the outpost set up a geomagnetic monitoring network on the grassland border. In the future, if there is an abnormality in the geomagnetic field, we will know immediately and no one will take advantage of it.
In less than twenty days, the case was handled neatly. After the newcomers came back, their eyes lit up.
When they were in the army, they all felt that they were the best, special forces, and extremely powerful. When I arrived at the Tianshu Bureau, I discovered that there were many powerful people. Lao Zhao's skills, experience, and judgment were miles ahead of them. Not to mention the legendary Director Wang, who is truly capable. This group of newcomers were completely convinced, and they knew that their previous abilities were not enough for the Tianshu Bureau.
In the days that followed, Wang Jianxin regarded this as an opportunity to train his troops.
After the integration of Bureau 749, the intelligence capabilities have reached a big level. In the past, many cases had to be handled by the Tianshu Bureau itself, which was time-consuming and labor-intensive. It's okay now. Bureau 749 sends over a bunch of intelligence analysis reports every now and then. The background, clues, and relevant figures of any case are all clear. What the Tianshu Bureau has to do is to send people to verify, arrest, and deal with it.
The cases are all kinds and all kinds. There are espionage cases, smuggling cases, cultural relic excavation cases, and some unexplained supernatural events. Wang Jianxin arranged ten field squadrons into shifts and took turns going out on missions. This month, the first squadron will go to the northeast, the second squadron will go to the southwest, and the third squadron will go to north China. Each case is a practical exercise, which not only trains individual soldier's ability, but also trains teamwork and adaptability.
Several deputy directors also have their own division of labor. Qin Huaizhou is responsible for overall planning, Lu Jinghong is responsible for training and tactical guidance, and Su Yanqiu is responsible for intelligence docking and technical support. Everyone performs their duties and is busy but not chaotic. Wang Jianxin saved a lot of worry and could free up his hands to take care of those important matters.
By the end of the year, I was finally not so busy.
The project in Qinghai has entered the winter break. The weather is 20 to 30 degrees below zero, and the concrete is frozen, making construction impossible. The engineering troops withdrew to rest and wait until next spring to resume work. The list of 100 people in the capital has also been decided, the training plan has been prepared, and we are just waiting for the base to be built.
